name: std::swap(std::promise)

declarations.code:
template <class R>

void swap(promise<R> &lhs, promise<R> &rhs) noexcept;

intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::promise. Exchanges the shared state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs).
